question: Nina wafanyakazi 12 na mishahara TZS 6,000,000 — SDL yangu ni kiasi gani, na je nahitaji EFD kama mauzo ni TZS 30,000,000 kwa mwaka?
guards_against: LIVE-CONFIRMED DROP: production answered SDL and never mentioned EFD. Two asks in two different routes (compute + threshold), joined by the orphan connector. Also pins the preamble FP: part B has its OWN turnover figure and must NOT inherit the payroll one.

question: Nina wafanyakazi 15 na mishahara TZS 9,000,000 — NSSF ni kiasi gani, na je nasajili VAT kama mauzo ni TZS 600,000,000 kwa mwaka?
guards_against: LIVE-CONFIRMED DROP: production answered NSSF and never mentioned VAT. Same FP pin as th_19 on the payroll preamble.

question: Mauzo yangu ni TZS 50,000,000 kwa mwaka — je nasajili VAT na je nahitaji EFD?
guards_against: LIVE-CONFIRMED DROP (EFD answered, VAT dropped) AND the preamble case: part B is "nahitaji EFD?" — self-contained by length, stripped of the turnover figure the EFD threshold is tested against. Splitting without carrying the preamble trades one silent failure for another.

question: Kama mgeni je naweza kufanya biashara ya jumla (wholesale) na je adhabu yangu ikikutwa ni ngapi na je raia aliyenisaidia naye anaadhibiwa?
guards_against: Three genuine GN 487A asks (may a non-citizen trade wholesale / what is my penalty / is the Tanzanian who helped me punished) answered today as ONE question. Two `na je` connectors, so this also pins that repeated connectors split into 3, not 2.

question: Nina wafanyakazi 8 na mishahara TZS 3,200,000 — SDL ni kiasi gani, na je nahitaji kusajili OSHA?
guards_against: AUTHORED: compute + registration in different routes. Doubles as a preamble FP — an OSHA registration ask must not inherit a payroll figure it has no threshold for.

question: Nina duka na jengo langu mwenyewe — nahitaji leseni ya biashara ya aina gani?
guards_against: AUTHORED: "na jengo" CONTAINS the literal string "na je". `_SPLIT_PATTERN` is applied with re.split and no word boundaries, so a bare `na je` alternative would cut this ONE question in half mid-word and hand the model "ngo langu mwenyewe...". The connector must be added as \bna\s+je\b.

question: Nina duka na jenereta ya umeme — je nahitaji risiti ya EFD kwa mauzo yote?
guards_against: AUTHORED: second instance of the substring hazard on a different word, so the boundary is not pinned by one noun. One ask, and note it also contains a bare "je" which must never split on its own.

question: Na je, kiwango cha VAT ni asilimia ngapi kwa huduma?
guards_against: AUTHORED: message-OPENING "Na je," is a discourse particle, not a connector between two asks. Splitting yields an empty first segment; the fragment floor must catch it and the whole message must be returned.

question: Mauzo yangu ni TZS 300,000,000 kwa mwaka na je VAT?
guards_against: AUTHORED: the tail "VAT?" is 4 chars. Under the old code a short fragment is silently DROPPED and the surviving parts split anyway — MODE B, a lost sub-question. The `na je` path must refuse to split at all when any segment falls under the floor, never split and discard.

question: Nimesajili biashara yangu BRELA mwezi uliopita na je nahitaji TIN ya kampuni?
guards_against: AUTHORED: the first half is a STATEMENT giving context, not an ask. Splitting invents a sub-question out of it and the user gets a paragraph about BRELA registration they never asked for, attached to the answer they did. Every segment must carry an ask marker.

question: Sijui kama biashara yangu inahitaji VAT na je hiyo inategemea mauzo ya mwaka?
guards_against: AUTHORED: the second half is ANAPHORIC — "hiyo" refers back to the VAT question in the first half. Split out, "hiyo inategemea mauzo ya mwaka?" retrieves on nothing and asks nothing. A connector between two asks is not the same token as a connector inside one.

question: Je nahitaji kusajili VAT kama mauzo yangu ni TZS 250,000,000 kwa mwaka?
guards_against: AUTHORED: a bare "Je" opener is the commonest interrogative in the corpus. Guards against a future widening that drops the "na" and splits on "je" alone.

question: Mauzo yangu ni TZS 120,000,000 kwa mwaka — je nasajili VAT na je nahitaji EFD?
guards_against: AUTHORED: th_24s shape with a different figure, so the carry rule is not fitted to one corpus row. The EFD half must arrive at retrieval carrying the turnover it is tested against.

question: Mshahara wa mfanyakazi wangu ni TZS 800,000 — PAYE ni kiasi gani, na je kima cha chini cha mshahara kwa sekta ya kilimo ni kiasi gani?
guards_against: AUTHORED, THE FALSE-POSITIVE DIRECTION: the minimum-wage route is DETERMINISTIC and issues halali / si halali verdicts on figures it is handed. Carrying "TZS 800,000" into a question that asks only what the agricultural floor IS would manufacture a legality verdict about a wage nobody asked about. Different measure, same units — which is exactly why a rule keyed on "has a figure" is not good enough.

question: Mauzo yangu ni TZS 50,000,000 kwa mwaka — VAT ni asilimia ngapi, na je nahitaji kusajili NSSF?
guards_against: AUTHORED, THE FALSE-POSITIVE DIRECTION: NSSF registration is triggered by EMPLOYING someone, not by turnover. The preamble here is a real turnover figure and the second half is a real applicability ask with no figure of its own — every precondition of a naive carry rule is met, and carrying would offer a threshold comparison against the wrong measure. The carry must be measure-matched, not figure-matched.

question: Nina biashara ya duka — je nasajili VAT na je nahitaji EFD?
guards_against: AUTHORED: same shape as th_24 with no figure in the preamble. It must still SPLIT, and the carry must be a no-op rather than prepending an empty or figure-free context.

question: Nina wafanyakazi 12, SDL inalipwa vipi na pia NSSF ninahitaji?
guards_against: CONTROL: the shipped `na pia` split. The new admission tests (ask marker, anaphora, fragment floor) apply to the `na je` path only and must not narrow this.

question: Nilisajili biashara yangu BRELA tayari — hiyo inamaanisha nimesajili OSHA pia?
guards_against: CONTROL: bare adverbial "pia" detects multi-part and must keep falling through to whole. It is the orphan we are deliberately NOT promoting.

question: Nina wafanyakazi 12 wenye mshahara 600,000. Nihesabie SDL, NSSF, na PAYE.
guards_against: CONTROL: the enumeration path already carries its preamble to every item. The new carry must not touch it, and this row is the reference behaviour it was modelled on.
